Commons' description identifies him as the Roman holy martyr of the 3rd century, a career soldier executed in the persecution of Diocletian — the martyr-soldier of Rome this folder records. Commons describes it: Sebastian is a Roman holy martyr from the 3rd century. A career soldier and Christian, he performed numerous miracles and contributed to numerous conversions. During the persecution of Diocletian, he was executed for his faith – first pierced with arrows and then killed with rods. Abbot Godescard (19th century) is the author of the book The Lives of the Holy Fathers & Martyrs.  Engraving by Ho
